content.text: ▪︎SBP <90 · weak periph pulses · lethargy · confusion · somnolence
▪︎SBP <90 on dobutamine: add NE - α1 ↑SVR counters dobutamine vasodilation · β1 ↑contractility
– dobutamine: β1 ↑contractility - β2 vasodilation may worsen BP
– EPI: alt when dobutamine unavailable - ↑β1/β2 affinity @ low doses - ↑acidosis · tachy · dysrhythmias vs NE + dobutamine
– milrinone: PDE inhibitor - ↑contractility · ↓SVR - alt to dobutamine in pts on BBs (⍉combine w dobutamine)
▪︎STEMI w cardiogenic shock: emergent hemodynamic support as temporizing measure → revasc
▪︎drop in BP when Δ from sitting/supine ⇢ standing
▪︎autonomic dysfun or intravasc vol depletion - up to 20% of pop (esp older adults)
▪︎baroreflex failure · severe vol depletion (GI losses · diuretics) · med SEs · chronic HTN
▪︎neurodegen dz (Parkinson · Lewy body dementia · multiple system atrophy) → autonomic failure → impaired vasoconstriction & inadeq HR response
: reflex tachy & vasoconstrict impaired (← autonomic dysfun) or overwhelmed ⇢ dep pooling of blood ⇢ hypotension & ↓cerebral perf
: faintness · dizziness · confusion or blurred vision that occur soon after standing & resolve rapidly w lying down - ± syncope
▪︎lightheadedness · syncope · ± musc aches or angina - ↑risk falls · CVD · cog impairment
: BP/HR measured after 5min supine & @ 1 & 3min after standing
▪︎DX = supine & standing BP - labs · autonomic funct tests · imaging may find cause - many idiopathic
▪︎urine Na <20mEq/L → kidneys reabsorbing Na & H2O to correct vol depletion
ddx postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS): chronic orthostatic intol w prolonged SXS w.o BP drop
▪︎tx underlying cause · lifestyle mods - pharm for severe
▪︎abrupt onset of hypotension followed by syncope
: trigger activates vagus n. ⇢ enhanced parasympathetic response ⇢ periph vasodilate & ↓HR · BP & contractility
